subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace or rejected by fs-safe?
rationale: The submitted backend fix resolves a visible false-Missing case by crossing the existing workspace file-access boundary, which is a product/security decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Reject raw external stats and solve the false-Missing UX by filtering or neutral-labeling external entries without exposing host filesystem metadata.

options.title: Allow External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Accept existence, size, and mtime disclosure for transcript-mentioned external files, but require maintainer security signoff and protocol/UI regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Reject raw external stats and solve the false-Missing UX by filtering or neutral-labeling external entries without exposing host filesystem metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blamed owner of the current gateway/UI source paths and likely best router for the boundary decision.
